Name: Red Leather Journal Cover — A5 Slim
Short description: Each cover is made to order, with leather and hand assembled by me! I wanted these journals to be durable, reusable and imperfect, something to grow and accompany its user through life and show character with every scratch and dent.
Description:
Each cover is made to order, with leather and hand assembled by me! I wanted these journals to be durable, reusable and imperfect, something to grow and accompany its user through life and show character with every scratch and dent.

The slim wrap/fold is to ensure any notebook inside is protected, and the elastic closure keeps everything secure, so feel free to toss it in your bag or take it on an adventure!

This one is the A5 slim in red. Also available in A6 slim, and in brown or black.

Since each piece is unique and real leather is used, natural variations in color, texture, markings, and aging are expected, but that’s what makes each one unique!
